scope: earliest reproducible divergence between historical SF2 and current-environment replays

update0_artifacts.meaning: pre-training forwards and baselines are bitwise reproducible; divergence enters during training steps.

historical_vs_replayA.update1_fields: byte-identical including loss, ce, kl, grad_norm

interpretation: Update 1 (the first forward+backward+step on parent weights) produces byte-identical losses and gradients; the first divergence appears in the update-2 forward, i.e. the effect of the first optimizer step differs between the historical environment and the current one. This locates the divergence in per-step training numerics (backward reductions / optimizer arithmetic / kernel behavior) rather than in initialization, RNG/mask draws, data order, or code.
unresolved_low_level: Which specific op/kernel/state changed is not identified by surviving evidence (see RUNTIME_PROVENANCE_COMPARISON.json).
